verified_facts.text: The hotel is the first international luxury hotel in Nara city center.
verified_facts.excerpt: The JW Marriott Nara, the first international luxury hotel in Nara city center, welcomes guests to enjoy sophistication with a personal touch.

verified_facts.text: It is the first JW Marriott in Japan.
verified_facts.excerpt: The JW Marriott Hotel Nara is the first international luxury hotel in Nara, and first JW Marriott in Japan

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms use warm orange and natural earth tones as a tribute to Nara's traditional Wakakusa Yamayaki festival.
verified_facts.excerpt: The guestrooms welcome guests with warm orange and natural earth tones, a tribute to Nara’s traditional “Wakakusa Yamayaki” festival.

verified_facts.text: The famous Nara deer motif is used as inspiration in the guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The famous Nara deer motif is also used as inspiration to provide guests with an enjoyable and uplifting experience.

verified_facts.text: All guest rooms are equipped with rain showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: All guest rooms are equipped with rain showers.

verified_facts.text: All rooms and suites feature Aromatherapy Associates bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms and suites at the hotel feature luxury UK brand “Aromatherapy Associates” amenities.

verified_facts.text: Spa by JW is designed to represent the serenity and purity of the Tenpyo-era temple architecture in and around Nara.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa by JW represents the serenity and purity of the Tenpyo architectural temples in and around Nara.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers massages and facials using Aromatherapy Associates products.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer guests a relaxing experience with massages and facial treatments using products from the world-renowned British brand "Aromatherapy Associates."

verified_facts.text: The spa includes a steam room and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa includes a steam room and sauna for guests to enjoy a tranquil luxurious atmosphere to de-stress from their daily routines.

verified_facts.text: All staying guests have access to the indoor pool, jacuzzi and a 24-hour fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: all staying guests have access to the indoor pool and jacuzzi as well as a 24-hour fitness center

verified_facts.text: The on-site JW Garden sources fresh herbs and vegetables used across the hotel's dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel embraces on-site JW Garden which sources fresh, sustainable herbs and vegetables, ingredients that feed the soul and restore the body which can be savored across the numerous distinctive dining experiences.

verified_facts.text: Azekura, the Japanese restaurant, has separate teppanyaki, sushi and kaiseki dining areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature Kaiseki restaurant in Nara city center features separate Teppanyaki, Sushi, and Kaiseki dining areas to ensure an authentic Japanese dining experience.

verified_facts.text: Silk Road Dining, the all-day restaurant, serves world cuisines from an open kitchen, inspired by Nara having been the final stop on the Silk Road.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy world cuisines in an open kitchen at our all-day dining restaurant, Silk Road Dining. The ancient capital...See More of Nara was the final stop on the Silk Road.

verified_facts.text: Flying Stag is a lounge bar featuring a hearth and specially curated artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in our stylish Nara city center bar and pub. Featuring beautifully designed sofas, a hearth, and specially curated artwork

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts a morning session every day that combines stretching, yoga and meditation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Participate in a one-hour session that combines stretching, yoga, and meditation every morning at our wellness hotel near Nara Park.

verified_facts.text: Local crafts and works by regional artists are showcased throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: We also celebrate Nara's cultural heritage by showcasing local crafts and works by regional artists throughout the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Through an Artist-in-Residence Program, works by Nara-based artist Chiharu Yoshina are displayed in the lobby and Flying Stag.
verified_facts.excerpt: Her pieces Multidimensional Blue and Meguru are displayed in the hotel’s lobby and Flying Stag areas, creating a space where architecture and art harmonize.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located near Nara Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mindful Morning YogaOur hotel, located near Nara Park, hosts "Mindful Morning Yoga" every day

verified_facts.text: The Heijo Palace Site and Todaiji Temple are nearby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nara Convention Center, Heijo Palace Site/平城京, Todaiji Temple/東大寺 and more are nearby JW Marriott Hotel Nara.

verified_facts.text: Nara is just over 30 minutes by train from Kyoto and Osaka.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just over 30 minutes by train from Kyoto and Osaka, Nara enjoys a convenient location with easy access to shinkansen lines connecting Tokyo, Fukuoka and other major Japanese cities.

verified_facts.text: The Family by JW program offers activities for children aged 5 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: For younger guests aged 5-12, the Family by JW™ program features an array of fun and engaging activities.

verified_facts.text: The hotel connects by bridge to the adjacent Nara Convention Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Nara hotel in Japan is connected to the Nara Convention Center adjacent to the hotel via a connecting bridge for easy transportation.

verified_facts.text: The Executive Lounge serves breakfast with Western and Japanese dishes, afternoon tea, and evening hors d'oeuvres with drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a curated breakfast with Western and Japanese dishes, a serene Afternoon Tea with premium sweets and teas, and evening hors d’oeuvres with drinks in an elegant setting.
